# netbox_l2vpn_terminations (Data Source)

Retrieves all l2vpn terminations from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_l2vpn_terminations" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "assigned_object_id"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "l2vpn_terminations_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_l2vpn_terminations.example.l2vpn_terminations[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `l2vpn_terminations` (Attributes List) The l2vpn terminations found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--l2vpn_terminations))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--l2vpn_terminations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `l2vpn_terminations`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_object` (String) The assigned object of the l2vpn terminations.
- `assigned_object_id` (Number) The assigned object id of the l2vpn terminations.
- `assigned_object_type` (String) The assigned object type of the l2vpn terminations.
- `created` (String) The created of the l2vpn terminations.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the l2vpn terminations, as a map of field name to value.
- `id` (Number) The id of the l2vpn terminations.
- `l2vpn_id` (Number) The ID of the l2vpn associated with the l2vpn terminations.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the l2vpn terminations.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
